This reading boosted investor optimism that the Federal Reserve will have room to lower interest rates at its next meeting, which could reduce borrowing costs for companies and consumers.

content.title: NNBR Q2 Deep Dive: Transformation Progress and New Business Drive Guidance Amid Market Uncertainty
content.summary: Industrial components supplier NN (NASDAQ:NNBR) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2025, with sales falling 12.3% year on year to $107.9 million. On the other hand, the company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ estimates with revenue guided to $445 million at the midpoint. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.02 per share was $0.02 above analysts’ consensus estimates.
